title: Try Unlimited Checklist Tracking on IGN’s GTA 5 Guides This November - IGN
summary: Yes, we’re finally getting GTA 6. We’ve held out this long, but as November 19th inches closer and closer, the wait has become almost unbearable. Why not dip your toes back into the world of Grand Theft Auto with a little trip down memory lane? There’s never been a better time to replay GTA 5, not just because GTA 6 is right around the corner, but because until December 4th, 2026 you can use unlimited checkmarks and interactive map markers to track your progress through GTA. Here’s a peek at what IGN’s GTA 5 checklists, maps, and guides have to offer. Grand Theft Auto 5 Checklists and Interactive Map You’re looking for a fix to hold you over until GTA 6... sounds like the perfect excuse to revisit GTA 5! Whether you’re looking to replay the main story , finally get the platinum trophy , or just mess around, IGN is here to help. Don’t get stuck on your second (or third… or fourth) playthrough of GTA 5. Follow along and use IGN’s walkthrough to measure your progress. For this month, you can use unlimited checkmarks to track which objectives you’ve completed and what you might have missed along the way. GTA 5 Story Missions walkthrough GTA 5 Strangers and Freaks walkthroughs How to Make Money in GTA 5 Already in the middle of your playthrough? Use IGN’s checklists to check off all the progress you’ve made so far and easily scan for what you’re missing. If you’re in the business of trophy hunting or hitting 100% completion, IGN guides have everything you need to stay organized. Here are just a few of our helpful guides for anyone trying to 100% GTA 5: 100 Percent Completion Checklist Achievements and Trophies Guide Collectibles Guides You might already be acquainted with Los Santos, but it’s a big world. Why rely on fuzzy memory when you can use IGN’s interactive map to find things not marked on your in-game map? From stores to vehicle spawns, our interactive Los Santos Blaine County map makes tracking down collectibles and locations easy. Be sure to use these GTA 5 checklists, completely free only from November 13th to December 4th, 2026 . Shailyn Cotten is the Guides Checklists Editor for the IGN Guides team. The only thing she loves more than checking off her to-do list is frogs... and possibly Breath of the Wild. You can find her managing the checklist database for some of your favorite IGN game guides.
